noCover.title: Factor Definitions and Premia Sources | 因子定义与溢价来源
noCover.titleSecondary: 什么是因子？为何获得溢价？
noCover.intent: Define factor, distinguish related terms, establish anomaly as model-relative, and separate risk from mispricing premia.
points: Factor captures cross-sectional return differences via systematic exposure
Anomaly is model-relative, not absolute; shrinks as benchmarks expand
Risk premia compensate bad-state wealth volatility permanently
Mispricing premia arise from behavioral bias or frictions, may vanish
Distinguish characteristic, factor, signal, anomaly, alpha precisely

noCover.title: Asset Pricing Lineage: CAPM to Multi-Factor Models | 资产定价谱系：从CAPM到多因子
noCover.intent: Trace the chronological evolution from CAPM through APT, FF3, Carhart4, FF5, q-factor, and SY models, including GRS testing intuition.
points: CAPM relies on mean-variance optimization; flat SML and Roll critique expose failures
APT legitimizes empirical multi-factor search without representative agent utility
FF3 adds size/value via independent double sort; Carhart4 adds momentum
FF5 links profitability/investment to dividend discount logic; q-factor derives from production theory
SY clusters anomalies behaviorally; GRS tests joint alpha significance across test assets

noCover.title: Explanations, Zoo Discipline, and Factor Taxonomy | 解释、动物园纪律与分类
noCover.titleSecondary: 风险/错误定价/数据挖掘评分与总表
noCover.intent: Present competing explanations per factor, define multiple-testing discipline for the zoo, and provide the master taxonomy table.
points: Risk, behavioral, friction explanations coexist; each predicts specific failure modes
Factor zoo demands economic rationale, point-in-time data, and multiple-testing control
Scorecard prompts falsification thinking per factor family
Master taxonomy organizes signals by family with typical controls required

noCover.title: Construction, Timing, Market Differences, and Strategy Pipeline | 构建、择时、市场差异与策略流程
noCover.titleSecondary: 从因子到可执行策略的实践桥梁
noCover.intent: Cover portfolio construction styles, timing/crowding risks, US vs A-share structural differences, the worked example template, strategy workflow, and final checklist.
points: Construction styles are not interchangeable; always report weighting, neutrality, costs
Timing adds multiple-testing layers; crowding unwinds violently when liquidity vanishes
US vs A-share differences in structure, constraints, and disclosure make factors hypotheses not truths
Independent sorting isolates marginal pricing effects from size proxies
Strategy requires full pipeline from rationale through paper trade to live allocation plus checklist

uncovered.title: Tutorial 04 — The Factor Zoo: Theory and Taxonomy of Equity Factors | 因子动物园：股票因子的理论与分类
uncovered.intent: Provide the theoretical spine, taxonomy, and practical discipline for understanding equity factor models and the factor zoo.
points: Asset-pricing lineage from CAPM to multi-factor models
Factor classification, premia debate, and statistical reality
Bridge from theory to practice: construction, timing, and checklists

uncovered.title: What Is a Factor? Definitions and Distinctions | 什么是因子？定义与区分
uncovered.intent: Define factors formally and distinguish them from related industry terms that are often conflated.
points: A factor is a systematic characteristic explaining cross-sectional return differences
Distinguish characteristic, factor, signal, anomaly, and alpha
Anomaly status is model-relative, not absolute; expanding benchmarks absorb past anomalies
Risk factors compensate for bad-state wealth volatility; mispricing factors capture behavioral corrections
Most documented factors blend risk and mispricing components

uncovered.title: Theoretical Lineage: From CAPM to Multi-Factor Models | 理论谱系：从CAPM到多因子模型
uncovered.intent: Trace how empirical failures of CAPM motivated APT and successive multi-factor models with distinct theoretical grounding.
points: CAPM derives from mean-variance optimization under strict assumptions; empirical SML is too flat
Size, value effects, and Roll's critique exposed CAPM limitations
APT legitimizes empirical factor hunting via no-arbitrage without specifying factors
FF3 adds size and value; Carhart4 adds momentum; FF5 links profitability and investment to dividend discount logic
q-factor uses production-based q-theory; SY clusters anomalies into behavioral mispricing composites

uncovered.title: Testing Frameworks: Time-Series, Cross-Sectional, and GRS | 检验框架：时间序列、截面与GRS
uncovered.intent: Clarify how factor models are tested and why joint significance tests matter beyond individual alphas.
points: Time-series regressions test whether factor returns explain portfolio returns
Cross-sectional tests examine if characteristics or betas explain average return differences
Characteristics can forecast returns without being clean covariance risk exposures
GRS test checks if a set of test-asset alphas is jointly zero under a model
GRS prevents one attractive alpha from masking broad model failure but depends on test-asset choice

uncovered.title: Why Factors Earn Premia and the Factor Zoo Problem | 因子为何获得溢价与因子动物园问题
uncovered.intent: Present competing explanations for factor premia and the statistical discipline required by the factor zoo.
points: Three recurring explanations: risk compensation, behavioral mispricing, market frictions
Practitioners need stories that predict when a factor fails, not pure camp membership
Hundreds of published anomalies cannot all be independent expected-return sources
New factors require economic rationale, point-in-time construction, robustness, and implementability
Multiple-testing awareness separates genuine signals from data-mined artifacts

uncovered.title: Factor Scorecard and Master Taxonomy | 因子评分卡与分类总表
uncovered.intent: Organize known factors by explanatory lens and family structure for systematic evaluation.
points: Each major factor carries risk, mispricing, and data-mining narratives simultaneously
Scorecard prompts falsification thinking rather than delivering verdicts
Taxonomy groups signals into families: value, momentum, quality, investment, low risk, liquidity, sentiment, alternative
Representative signals and typical controls define each family's boundaries
Alternative data factors require careful coverage bias and timestamping controls

uncovered.title: Portfolio Construction Styles and Factor Timing | 组合构建方式与因子择时
uncovered.intent: Distinguish non-interchangeable construction approaches and address the risks of timing and crowding.
points: Long-short academic factors test premia; long-only tilts test benchmark-relative selection
Construction choices include weighting, rebalancing frequency, breakpoints, neutrality, and costs
Factor timing adds information but introduces another multiple-testing layer
Crowded factors work until liquidity vanishes, then unwind violently
Monitor common holdings, ETF flows, borrow costs, and manager correlations for crowding signals

uncovered.title: US vs A-Shares, Worked Example, and Strategy Pipeline | 美股与A股对比、算例与策略流程
uncovered.intent: Ground factor theory in market-specific realities, illustrate construction mechanics, and define the path to strategy.
points: Imported factors are hypotheses requiring local validation due to structural differences
A-share momentum depends on horizons and limit events; size reflects shell value and quant crowding
Independent double sorting prevents factors from becoming mere size proxies
A factor becomes a strategy only after universe rules, execution assumptions, capacity, and governance
Workflow progresses from economic rationale through red-teaming to small live allocation

uncovered.title: Practical Checklist and Summary | 实践清单与小结
uncovered.intent: Provide final evaluation criteria and synthesize the tutorial's core message about disciplined factor research.
points: Good factors are known at use, have pre-backtest rationale, and survive neutralization
IC, portfolio sorts, and regression tests must agree directionally across horizons and universes
Factors must survive costs, turnover, and not merely rename existing exposures
Every factor needs a documented failure story and monitoring plan
The factor zoo is both vocabulary and warning: combine theory, data discipline, cost realism, and humility

repairable.title: Theoretical Lineage I: CAPM, Its Failures, and APT | 理论谱系一：CAPM、其失败与 APT
repairable.intent: Trace the one-factor origin, its empirical rejections, and the no-arbitrage generalization that enables multi-factor empirics.

repairable.title: Theoretical Lineage II: Empirical Multi-Factor Models | 理论谱系二：实证多因子模型

repairable.intent: Distinguish time-series and cross-sectional tests and position GRS as a joint-alpha diagnostic.

repairable.title: Why Premia Exist and the Factor Zoo Problem | 溢价来源与因子动物园问题
repairable.intent: Present competing explanations for premia and define the statistical reality that constrains new factor claims.
points: Risk compensation, behavioral mispricing, and market frictions are coexisting explanations
Practitioners need failure-mode predictions, not pure camp allegiance
Hundreds of published anomalies include aliases, subsumed signals, costly trades, and false discoveries
New factors require economic rationale, point-in-time construction, robustness, and multiple-testing awareness

repairable.title: Factor Scorecard and Master Taxonomy | 因子评分卡与分类总表
repairable.intent: Organize known factors by explanation type and family to guide evaluation and control selection.
points: Scorecard maps each factor to risk story, mispricing story, and data-mining concern
Taxonomy table lists families, representative signals, and typical neutralizing controls
Scorecard prompts falsification thinking rather than delivering verdicts

repairable.title: Portfolio Construction Styles and Factor Timing/Crowding | 组合构建方式与因子择时/拥挤
repairable.intent: Clarify that construction choices change what is being tested and that timing adds testing layers while crowding changes risk profiles.
points: Long-short, dollar-neutral, long-only tilt, residualized, and mimicking portfolios serve different purposes
Always report weighting, rebalancing, breakpoints, neutrality, leverage, and cost assumptions
Timing indicators add information but also another multiple-testing layer; diversify as safer default
Crowded factors work until liquidity vanishes; monitor holdings overlap, flows, borrow cost, and turnover spikes

repairable.title: US vs A-Shares, Worked Sort Example, and Strategy Pipeline | 美股与A股差异、分组算例与策略流程
repairable.intent: Ground factor theory in market-specific realities, illustrate sort mechanics, and separate academic factors from implementable strategies.
points: Imported factors are hypotheses; US momentum is canonical while A-share momentum depends on limits and horizons
Independent sorting avoids size-proxy contamination; template applies across factor families
A strategy requires universe rules, execution assumptions, risk limits, capacity, and governance beyond the factor itself
Workflow proceeds from rationale through red-teaming to constrained paper trade and small live allocation

repairable.title: Practical Checklist and Summary | 实践清单与小结
repairable.intent: Provide a final gate for factor viability and synthesize the tutorial's dual role as library and warning.
points: Checklist demands pre-backtest rationale, neutralization survival, directional agreement, cost resilience, and failure monitoring
Factor zoo offers vocabulary for systematic patterns but warns against beautiful false discoveries from noisy finite data
Good research combines theory, data discipline, conservative testing, cost realism, and regime humility
Final model table consolidates year, factors, count, and theoretical grounding across all lineages discussed
